links.comparator_used: All LLM predictions retained, with no confidence-based filtering
links.outcome: Multiclass MCC of GPT-5 gait classification
links.effect: Multiclass MCC increased to 0.83 on the high-confidence filtered subset, compared with 0.70 for GPT-5 with reference grounding on all predictions
links.tradeoff: The 0.83 applies only to the filtered subset. The abstract does not report how many cases were excluded. The confidence signal is the LLM's self-rating.
links.quote: Performance of the LLM was highly dependent on explicit reference information and self-rated confidence; when restricted to high-confidence predictions, multiclass MCC increased to 0.83 on the filtered subset.

design_hint: retrieval/reference grounding and confidence-based filtering of LLM outputs
